lessons.idea: BWXT, the naval and nuclear-fuel monopoly: its backlog turns into revenue while new orders keep up.
lessons.falsifier: A Q4 book-to-bill of 1.0 or better (report about 2027-02-22, estimated). That would open a new case, not revive this one: the kill condition set in advance fired, with book-to-bill at 0.72 in Q2 and 0.56 in Q3.

lessons.idea: CMI, the generator maker inside a truck-engine company: power margins rose and the stock got cheaper. Nearest to enterable of the five.
lessons.falsifier: CMI closes above $500.10 (its 10-30 close) before its Q4 report (about 2027-02-05, estimated): waiting cost the entry.

lessons.idea: CEG, the nuclear fleet selling to hyperscalers on long contracts priced outside the auction cap. Watch until its report.
lessons.falsifier: The report cuts full-year guidance (kill), or holds it and the stock is back above $300.40 within 20 sessions (waiting cost the entry).

lessons.idea: SPXC, the cooling-tower maker: the backlog grows, but the cooling margin outlook was cut and the stock trades with the crowded AI names.
lessons.falsifier: SPXC closes above $165.20 (its 10-28 close, before its report) by 2027-02-23 while its margin outlook keeps falling.

lessons.idea: ET, the pipeline feeding data centers: guidance raised, but its data-center customer (Oracle) is borrowing at 7–8.65%.
lessons.falsifier: A rating agency cuts Oracle below investment grade before ET's Q4 report (about 2027-02-17, estimated): kill.

lessons.idea: The 28 energy-for-AI names trade as one bet on hyperscaler spending: all 28 fell on 11-05, and 25 of 28 fell on 11-04 while the S&P rose.
lessons.falsifier: The next session where the median name falls 5% or more has fewer than 20 of the 28 down.

lessons.idea: Dominion (D) as a cheap regulated utility: the cheap claim rested on a miscited baseline, and the market reprices it monthly.
lessons.falsifier: Reopens only on new evidence: the 08-12 study's kill list says never re-propose it from this evidence.

lessons.idea: NuScale (SMR) on a liquidity floor: its real burn is 3.7 times the misquoted figure, and the floor is kept up by the dilution that is the risk.
lessons.falsifier: Reopens only on new evidence: the 08-12 study's kill list says never re-propose it from this evidence.

lessons.idea: UEC as a uranium-miner play on AI power: uranium miners were an exhausted class with zero survivors.
lessons.falsifier: Reopens only on new evidence: the 08-12 study's kill list says never re-propose it from this evidence.

lessons.idea: MOD as a cooling play: up 730%, the crowded cooling proxy since January 2025.
lessons.falsifier: Reopens only on new evidence: the 08-12 study's kill list says never re-propose it from this evidence.

lessons.idea: CEG as a midterm-election catalyst: the auction cap holds through the 2029/30 delivery year whoever wins. Kills this angle only, so it names no symbol and CEG stays on watch for its contracts.
lessons.falsifier: The cap is lifted before the 2029/30 delivery year ends, so an election result could move the capacity price again.
